wardbound.adv.first_minigame.desc: Enter a ward minigame. The interface is the lock, not a decoration around it.
wardbound.adv.first_resolution.desc: Resolve your first physical ward. More systems begin to notice completed wards than attempted ones.
wardbound.adv.first_failure.desc: Lose a ward attempt. Failure is recorded; repeated failure can change later encounters.
wardbound.adv.scraped_win.desc: Win with a Scraped grade. A win still counts, but the ward knows how untidy it was.
wardbound.adv.clean_win.desc: Earn a Clean resolution. Clean work matters to Attention, mastery and some makers.
wardbound.adv.perfect_win.desc: Earn a Perfect resolution. Some disciplines record their own names for perfection.
wardbound.adv.first_card.desc: Sign your first card. Cards can alter future wards as well as ordinary life.
wardbound.adv.witness_ledger.desc: Open the Witness Ledger. It is the record of your wards, cards, mastery, anomalies and profile.
wardbound.adv.mastery_i.desc: Reach Mastery I in any ordinary discipline. Mastery unlocks harder forms instead of making the base puzzle easier.
wardbound.adv.mastery_iii.desc: Reach Mastery III in a discipline. Deep and expert behavior becomes increasingly relevant.
wardbound.adv.mastery_v.desc: Reach Mastery V in a discipline. You are no longer merely familiar with that grammar.
wardbound.adv.maker_familiar.desc: Become familiar with one sealmaker. A maker is not just a name; its wards carry a mechanical handwriting.
wardbound.adv.anomaly_seen: That Is Not How It Worked Before
wardbound.adv.anomaly_seen.desc: Witness an anomaly or corrupted behavior. Familiar mechanisms can become deliberately wrong.
wardbound.adv.conjunction_seen.desc: Discover a card Conjunction. Some rules matter because of what they meet, not what they do alone.
wardbound.adv.hybrid_cleared.desc: Clear a rare hybrid micro-round embedded inside another minigame.
wardbound.adv.unlock_cards.desc: Ordinary Wardbound cards are now part of the progression. A resolved chest may lead to a choice instead of silence.
wardbound.adv.unlock_field_cards.desc: Field-card systems are now eligible. Sealed Cards and hands away from a chest are worth watching for.
wardbound.adv.unlock_master_cards.desc: Master-authored cards can now enter the deck. Relationships with makers change what they offer.
wardbound.adv.unlock_curses.desc: Curse cards are now eligible. Some curses also mature, pair, and corrupt one another.
wardbound.adv.unlock_deception.desc: Late wards may lie through one feedback channel. They must still leave another channel truthful.
wardbound.adv.unlock_hybrids.desc: Rare cross-minigame micro-rounds are now eligible. The host puzzle pauses while the intrusion is active.
wardbound.adv.unlock_epics.desc: Epic cards can now appear. Their rules are rarer because they follow you farther.
wardbound.adv.unlock_covenants.desc: Covenants can now enter the card system. Fulfilling one leaves a persistent stain on later hands.
wardbound.adv.unlock_uniques.desc: Unique cards are now eligible. These are not ordinary deck filler and should not feel repeatable.
wardbound.adv.unlock_eldritch.desc: Eldritch multi-stage wards are now eligible. Winning one screen may only reveal the next seal.
wardbound.adv.unlock_savant.desc: The Savant can now enter the late reward ecology. It comments on systems because it actually reads your history.
wardbound.adv.unlock_death.desc: Death cards are now eligible. They are deliberately rarer and more consequential than ordinary bargains.
wardbound.adv.unlock_cthulhus_game.desc: Cthulhu's Game is now eligible. It is a final exam built from the wider minigame system and your recorded profile.
wardbound.adv.cthulhus_game_exam.desc: Enter Cthulhu's Game. Its route remembers what you were good at before you arrived.
wardbound.adv.first_chest.desc: A chest refuses to open. The ward has turned an ordinary container into a problem.
wardbound.adv.rusted_key.desc: It fits no ordinary lock. Carry it anyway; sealed containers will answer it.
silas.encounter_hint: A scabbard ring answers the wind only once. Someone may be waiting beside the road ahead.
silas.busy: Let me finish this. Stand back one step.
silas.too_early: You have not yet begun to ask what price the road is teaching you to pay. Return when that question has started to trouble you.
silas.master.ashen_curator: Curator: Silas Veyr. His record was not erased. Curious; after so much loss, he still resists becoming a mere footnote.
item.wardbound.silas_fragment.desc: A loose piece of Wardbound record with no trustworthy custodian.
item.wardbound.silas_fragment.read: Right-click to read it and copy it into the Witness Ledger.
silas.fragment.unknown: The ink refuses to hold the text.
silas.dialogue.1.0: You are looking at the sword. Most people do now. My name is Silas Veyr. Once, doors opened before me; now whenever one closes, I think first of who remained behind it.
silas.dialogue.1.1: If the road has stopped you here, then you have lost more than haste. On certain evenings a person wants nothing but a stone to sit on and a silence safe enough to trust.
silas.dialogue.1.2: Nhal-Sûl remained with me. After a long catastrophe, one learns not to count what one still carries, but what refused to abandon him.
silas.dialogue.1.3: I am in no condition to scatter lessons. Only remember this: not every open door is an invitation. Some thresholds measure what you leave behind more carefully than what enters.
silas.dialogue.1.4: They once called me champion. The word sits badly now. A man learns late that some titles are merely advance receipts for what will be taken from him.
silas.dialogue.2.0: There were three of us. Sera found the road. İlen closed our wounds. I stood in front. The first broken seal saved a village; after the second they called us heroes. The disaster did not begin with our first defeat. It began when we thought we were winning.
silas.dialogue.2.1: Sera wrapped Nhal-Sûl’s grip. İlen repaired the broken edge. Sometimes I think I carry not a sword, but the marks of two people who refused to abandon me.
silas.dialogue.2.2: Success teaches a strange arithmetic. What was unthinkable yesterday becomes “a price I could pay” today. First a person loses fear; then he loses the boundary fear was guarding.
silas.dialogue.2.3: Sera disliked great victories. She preferred quiet mornings, burnt coffee, and İlen’s dreadful songs. One rarely understands the value of ordinary things until they have become impossible.
silas.dialogue.2.4: İlen once told me, “If a road keeps convincing us to give more of ourselves, perhaps it is not a road.” I laughed then. Some sentences gain their weight only after the speaker is gone.
silas.dialogue.3.0: If you want their names, hear them: the Gambler, the Curator, the Notary. One prices your choice, one chooses what your memory may keep, and one seals the pain left behind as though it had always been necessary.
silas.dialogue.3.1: The Gambler need not deceive you. It does something worse: it guesses what you want correctly. Then it seats that desire at the table and returns it to you as though it were your own hand.
silas.dialogue.3.2: The Curator does not wish to know everything. It wishes to decide what deserves remembrance. It can kill the last trustworthy page proving a life existed before it kills the life itself.
silas.dialogue.3.3: The Notary’s judgment is often heavier than a blade. It does not cut; it makes the wound appear necessary. That is where a person begins to mistake coercion for consent.
silas.dialogue.3.4: They do not want the same thing. Sometimes they spoil one another’s accounts; sometimes one pulls you from another’s hand. Do not call it help. A toy stretched between two hands does not ask which hand is kinder.
silas.dialogue.4.0: What silenced me was not the wound. It was the patience waiting behind the wound. Once you truly lose to them, defeat leaves the body and settles into the thought.
silas.dialogue.4.1: There was a time my hand went to the sword when I saw them. It still does. The difference is that it used to go there to draw.
silas.dialogue.4.2: If a man returns from death once, he calls it a miracle. The second time, a curse. Later he stops counting. I no longer remember when I stopped.
silas.dialogue.4.3: Sometimes I remember the instant my heart stopped. I do not remember what came after, because nothing came after. The world seemed to forget to finish my sentence.
silas.dialogue.4.4: It would be easy to say I can no longer oppose them. More accurately: some place inside me believes every act of defiance will only return me to their game. Fear is sometimes not flight, but faith that the ending has already been written.
silas.dialogue.5.0: You brought one of them down. You do not need to hear that from me.
silas.dialogue.5.1: You have not arrived where I did. Good. Do not.
silas.dialogue.5.2: Nhal-Sûl is here. So am I. Your road still expects an answer from you. I am only a witness now.
silas.fragment.innkeepers_account: The inn ledger ends: “The traveler stayed three nights. He ate, paid, and never slept. On the fourth morning his shirt held more blood than a man could survive. He walked out under his own power.” The name column has been scraped away with a knife.
silas.fragment.names_on_the_grip: Two repairs remain on Nhal-Sûl’s grip. The first is fine, regular, careful: Sera’s work. The second is crude but strong, a dark seam holding the broken edge: İlen’s hand. The sword carries a more complete memory than its owner.
silas.fragment.physicians_refusal: “The patient’s heart had stopped. I checked three times. I covered him. One hour later I heard breathing beneath the sheet. I removed his name from this page. I will not enter this in my medical ledger.”
silas.fragment.unclaimed_hand: Three lines remain on a blackened game slip: “STAKE: VEYR, SILAS / PAYMENT: ACCEPTED / OUTCOME: —”. The final dash is not ink. The place reserved for an outcome still seems to be waiting.
silas.fragment.archive_44_v: “Subject: Veyr, Silas. Death: indexed. Final state: unavailable. Cause: record disagreement.” Two of the three references beneath it have been burned. The third is sealed.
silas.fragment.death_certificate_without: The document contains Silas Veyr’s name, date of death and cause. “WITNESS:” is blank. The signature line is cracked through its center. The date is older than the archive holding it; the ink is newer.
silas.fragment.seras_morning: In Sera’s hand: “Silas burned the coffee again. İlen ordered us to drink it because waste is a sin. If we must be heroes again tomorrow, I refuse to leave bed before noon today.” Nothing else follows.
silas.fragment.champions_return: Guard report: “I told Veyr I had buried him two months earlier. He did not believe me. I showed him my own mark on Nhal-Sûl’s grip. Then he stopped believing himself.”
silas.fragment.curator_cross_reference: Curator cross-reference: “The subject persists because no single ending retains exclusive authority.” Below: “Death record present. No final version holds singular ownership.”
silas.fragment.silas_private_margin: In Silas’s hand: “I thought I hated them. I was wrong. Hatred still believes the thing before it can be defeated. Now I only hear their voices and remember my old decisions.”
silas.fragment.notary_addendum: Notary addendum: “DEATH ACKNOWLEDGED. CONCLUSION DENIED. MATTER REMAINS IN FORCE.” A smaller note: “The judgment cannot terminate while the witness line remains unclosed.”
silas.fragment.curator_final_annotation: Curator’s final annotation: “Veyr persists. There is no archival basis for concluding that this constitutes mercy.” Footnote: “Refusal of the final offer was consistent. Consistency is not salvation.”
silas.fragment.title.death_certificate_w: The Death Certificate Without a Death
silas.fragment.not_yet: The ink does not yet behave as testimony meant for you.
item.wardbound.silas_fragment.assemble: Sneak-right-click with the complete physical set to bind all twelve fragments.
silas.fragment.assemble_progress: The testimony is incomplete: %s/12 physical fragments are present.
item.wardbound.unconcluded_testimony.des: Twelve incompatible records bound into one thing that should not exist.
item.wardbound.unconcluded_testimony.use: Return it to Silas Veyr when the names behind the game are no longer hidden from you.
item.wardbound.worn_scabbard_ring.desc: A blackened iron ring polished smooth by years of use. It does not appear valuable.
item.wardbound.worn_scabbard_ring.call: Right-click: call Silas Veyr. His ordinary presence lasts 90 seconds; the timer pauses during Master Phases I–II. When Phase III begins, the Master forcibly dismisses Silas and the ring will not answer again during that phase.
item.wardbound.worn_scabbard_ring.master: Old fear no longer closes this road.
silas.dialogue.testimony_not_yet: Silas looks at the bound testimony but does not take it. ‘Not yet. You found the pages. You have not yet seen the shape they make between them. Keep walking.’
silas.dialogue.testimony_already_given: Silas glances at the record, then at the ring he already entrusted to you. ‘Keep the copy. I have carried enough versions of that life.’
silas.dialogue.ring_reward: Silas does not reach for the testimony at first. He reads the physician, the blank witness line, the unfinished wager. At Sera’s Morning his hand stops. “Where did you find this?” A long silence. “No. Never mind.” He closes the pages, removes a small blackened ring from Nhal-Sûl’s scabbard and places it in your hand. “If you call, I will come. If the road leads back to them... this time I will try not to turn away.”
nhal_sul.history: A second Nhal-Sûl, finished beneath a hammer older than the Masters.
nhal_sul.awakened: The cut ended. The silence behind it is still opening.
nhal_sul.skill: Unwritten Cut — right-click to sever the space ahead. 12 s cooldown.
nhal_sul.damage: 40 total attack damage. Unbreakable; no durability lifecycle.
nhal_sul.resonance_ready: The black seam in Nhal-Sûl answers without asking for another proof.
silas.dialogue.nhal_awakened_unknown: Put it down for a moment. That opening in the blade... mine has never done that. Nhal-Sûl never showed me such a cut. Whatever answered you, I cannot teach you what it wants.
ancient_smith.dialogue.endures: A thing endures. Or it breaks.
ancient_smith.dialogue.masters: They play games. I forge metal.
ancient_smith.dialogue.second_one: I did not ask for a second one.

wardbound.adv.unlock_chains.desc: Seal chains are now eligible. One ward may point toward another instead of ending cleanly.
wardbound.adv.unlock_contracts.desc: Contract hands can now bind explicit objectives to their payment.

wardbound.adv.unlock_unsigned.desc: Unsigned seals are now eligible: rare wards without an ordinary maker signature.

wardbound.adv.unlock_revision_ii.desc: Deeper card revisions can now become eligible.
wardbound.adv.unlock_revision_iii.desc: The deepest revision tier is now eligible. Some laws may stop behaving like disposable clauses.

wardbound.adv.echo_signed.desc: Sign an Echo card. Its amplification is consumed by one later matching card, never permanently.

wardbound.adv.nhal_sul_awakened.desc: Awaken Nhal-Sûl by releasing its first Unwritten Cut.
wardbound.adv.unlock_house_measure.desc: Reach the point where ordinary wards begin forming Opening, Pressure and Verdict measures.
wardbound.adv.house_measure_verdict.desc: Reach a House Measure Verdict and face a clause built from a ward rule you already learned.

wardbound.adv.mulligan_banked.desc: Bank a Cut by strong Measure play or by folding an entire ordinary card hand.
wardbound.adv.mulligan_spent.desc: Spend a Cut to redraw exactly one visible offer in an ordinary hand.
wardbound.adv.ecology_warm.desc: Raise one card family to Warm Heat; the House can now read a repeated preference.
wardbound.adv.ecology_watched.desc: Raise one family to Watched Heat and make the next legal shelves start answering the pattern.
wardbound.adv.ecology_answered.desc: Raise one family to Answered Heat; the House now pushes counter-families without breaking rarity rules.
wardbound.adv.category.cards.desc: Bargains, card families, revisions, conjunctions and the House memory written by your signatures.
wardbound.adv.category.disciplines.desc: Minigame disciplines, mastery grades, corrupted examinations and execution milestones.
wardbound.adv.category.house.desc: House Measure, Cuts, card masters, private signatures and the relationships behind the hand.
wardbound.adv.category.secrets.desc: Anomalies, attention, hidden witnesses, master defeats and records not intended for an ordinary ledger.
wardbound.adv.cthulhu_head_defeated.desc: Defeat the severed Head after entering from the End. Its true body was never present.
wardbound.adv.discipline_orrery.desc: Resolve a Black Orrery ward. Its coupled gear law is now catalogued in the Ledger.
wardbound.adv.discipline_procession.desc: Resolve a Last Procession ward. Its witness-order law is now catalogued in the Ledger.
wardbound.adv.fifth_wave_law.desc: Sign one of the Fifth-Wave laws that reacts to ward performance, movement, wounds or the surrounding world.
wardbound.adv.defeat_maestro.desc: Defeat the once-human artist who crossed realms along a road the three known Masters never knew, and who witnessed Cthulhu erase worlds without ever challenging it.
wardbound.adv.maestro_revealed.desc: Conclude the Gambler, Curator and Notary, then find a score written by an author whose road never touched theirs.
